headlines.title: Intel’s 45% Downturn Over 3 Months Unsettles Investors: This Wall Street Analyst Predicts 155% Gains Anyway
headlines.summary: Intel just posted its best server quarter in 15 years, yet the stock cratered anyway. One analyst still sees a path to more than double from here, while others see a turnaround with no committed customers. Who is reading the data right?

headlines.title: Why Is Intel Stock Falling 3.1% in Pre-Market Trading?
headlines.summary: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) shares declined 3. 1% in pre-market trading on Tuesday, following reports that Nvidia had reduced its investment in the semiconductor manufacturer and amid shareholder lawsuits concerning Intel’s financial disclosures.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Intel (INTC) on Friday
headlines.summary: Intel (INTC) drew $28.3 million in net ETF selling last Friday.

headlines.title: Intel falls premarket as Nvidia cuts stake, SpaceX becomes top holding
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Intel shares fell more than 3% in premarket trading Tuesday after Nvidia significantly trimmed its stake in the chipmaker.

headlines.title: IREN Stock Rises Overnight As Intel Reveals Stake, Anthropic IPO Buzz Catches On
headlines.summary: Intel revealed in an SEC filing on Monday that it held 1.29 million shares of IREN, valued at about $52.75 million, as of Sept. 30.

description: Intel Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and services computing and related end products and services in the United States, Ireland, Israel, and internationally. It operates through three segments: CCG, DCAI, and Intel Foundry. The company offers client computing group products, including client and commercial CPUs, discrete client GPUs, edge computing, and connectivity products; data center and AI products, such as server CPUs, discrete GPUs, and networking products; and semiconductors comprising wafer fabrication, substrates, and other related products and services. It also provides driving assistance and self-driving solutions; and develops and manufactures multi-beam mask writing tools. The company sells its products through sales organizations, distributors, resellers, retailers, and OEM partners. It serves original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers, cloud service providers, and other manufacturers and service providers. Intel Corporation has a strategic collaboration with Infosys Limited to develop a multi-layer AI fabric that unifies infrastructure, models, data, applications, and workflows into a composable and agent-ready ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
